info.name: Customer API v3
info.description: Complete Postman collection for all customer-facing API routes in routes/api_customer.php. Envelope convention: {success, message, data} on success (ApiResponse::success) and {success:false, message, errors} on failure (ApiResponse::error). Paginated list endpoints use {success, data:{items, meta}} (ApiResponse::paginated).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token refresh, password reset, email verification, session.

request.description:
Register a new customer account. Throttled 10 requests/minute. Sends verification email. Auto-captures access_token/refresh_token into collection variables.

**Path params:**
- country (string, required): site_code.

**Body fields:**
- name (string, required, max:255).
- email (string, required, email, max:255, unique).
- phone (string, optional, max:20, unique).
- password (string, required, min:8, must be confirmed via password_confirmation).
- password_confirmation (string, required, must match password).
- referral_code (string, optional, size:8).

**Throttle:** Rate limited: 10 requests / 1 minute.
